explication: Slidev is a Markdown-based presentation system for developers. Authors write slide content and configure themes; the parser and Node/Vite runtime prepare a presentation that the Vue client renders and navigates. The client also provides interactive slide features and dedicated presenter, drawing, recording, and export experiences. A VS Code extension adds project discovery and an editor preview. The README documents the main capabilities; some runtime links are shown as unverified where the supplied excerpts do not expose their wiring.
